description: MainMobileActivity.java is an Android activity that manages communication with connected Wear OS devices, checking for the presence of a specific capability (the Wear app), and providing functionality to open the app's Play Store page on devices without the app installed. It handles API connections, capability updates, and UI updates based on device state.

classes.name: MainMobileActivity
classes.description: An Android AppCompatActivity that interacts with Wear devices to verify app installation and launch app store intent if necessary.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, and GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability listener and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Adds capability listener, retrieves devices with app, and all connected devices.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when capabilities change, indicating app installation status.

methods.name: findWearDevicesWithApp
methods.description: Queries for connected Wear devices with specific capability (app installed).

methods.name: verifyNodeAndUpdateUI
methods.description: Updates UI based on devices with/without app installed.

methods.name: openPlayStoreOnWearDevicesWithoutApp
methods.description: Opens Play Store on devices that do not have the app installed.
